𝐑𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬: 𝐇𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐌𝐞𝐭𝐚𝐩𝐧𝐞𝐮𝐦𝐨𝐯𝐢𝐫𝐮𝐬 (𝐇𝐌𝐏𝐕)

As of yesterday, The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has identified two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Bengaluru through routine surveillance.(1/3)

𝐑𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬: 𝐇𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐌𝐞𝐭𝐚𝐩𝐧𝐞𝐮𝐦𝐨𝐯𝐢𝐫𝐮𝐬 (𝐇𝐌𝐏𝐕)

As of yesterday, The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has identified two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Bengaluru through routine surveillance.(1/3)

nodes.author: CommActCollab
nodes.text:
While HMPV is not a new virus, this serves as an important reminder to stay vigilant and maintain good health practices.

Follow @Precisi0nHealth   for credible updates and stay informed. Prioritise your health with reliable information.(2/3)
